system.description:
Using precise aim, you can hit two targets with a single shot.

Prerequisite: Point-Blank Shot

Effect: When you successfully make a ranged attack against a single target, you can make a second attack roll against an additional target that is in direct line of sight, and no farther than 6 squares from the original target. If the second attack roll succeeds, make a single damage roll, and divide the damage equally between the two targets. If the second attack roll fails, you deal no damage to either target.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
